title: Undergraduate Advanced Selected Topics in Biology; Synthetic Biology and Biological Engineering
description:
Restricted to Biological Sciences majors.

Prerequisite: C- or better in BSCI207, BSCI330, and MATH141; and permission on of BSCI (email bscique@umd.edu).

Credit only granted for: BSCI439J or BIOE461.

Students are introduced to scientific foundation and concepts of synthetic biology and biological engineering. Current examples that apply synthetic biology to fundamental and practical challenges will be emphasized. The course will also address the societal issues of synthetic biology, and briefly examine interests to regulate research in this area.

(Sponsoring Dept.: BSCI). Acceptable toward BSCI Area credits of CEBG and PHNB; Enrichment for ECEV and MICB; and the Cell Biology category of GENB.

Only one course of the following can be applied to a BSCI degree: BSCI439E, BSCI439G, BSCI439I, BSCI439J, and BSCI439K.
